'''FK Smiltene/BJSS''' is a [[Latvia]]n football club. They compete in the second-highest division of Latvian football ([[Latvian First League|1. līga]]) and [[Latvian Football Cup]].<ref name="soccerway">{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/latvia/fk-smiltene-bjss/15828/|title=Latvia – FK Smiltene BJSS – Results, fixtures, squad, statistics, photos, videos and news – Soccerway|publisher=uk.soccerway.com|accessdate=2015-02-18}}</ref>
They are based in [[Smiltene]]."}}
